title: FactRecord
description: The only carrier of numbers/claims between modules. Markdown tables are rendered from these, never the reverse.

id.description: e.g. F-REV-FY2024-CONS-001; EXT- prefix for external facts; D- for derived; EST- for estimates

metric.description: snake_case canonical key, e.g. revenue_from_operations, gnpa_pct, capex_guidance

label.description: human label as printed in source

value.description: exact as printed (no rounding) or 'N/A — missing <field>'

unit.description: INR_cr | INR_mn | pct | x | days | count | text — as per source

level.description: 1 = face of statement, 2 = notes breakdown, 3 = deeper note detail

parent.description: fact id this is a breakdown of

impacts.description: external facts only: module names whose findings this may invalidate
